correctness.rationale: Ground one leader and complete the square in its opinion coordinate; the grounded Green matrix entries are (R_ur+R_vr-R_uv)/2. Sherman–Morrison then yields the stated exact two-leader trace formula with g=1+κR_rt/2. Eigenspace decomposition of complete multipartite Laplacian proves within-part resistance 2/(n-a) and between-part formula (a-1)/(a(n-a))+(b-1)/(b(n-b))+(1/a+1/b)/n. The five symmetry orbits exhaust m>=2 cases, with m=1 singleton symmetry reducing to three. Exact rational differences in source are strictly positive for m=1,2,3; for m>=4 positivity follows coefficientwise on replacing m=u+4>=4 in N_BB and N_CC and the displayed positive N_UC,N_BC. Independent exact-Fraction Gaussian inversion of 32 pairs of (m,κ) scenarios (m=1..8, κ=1/7,1,9,60), comparing every admissible orbit, reproduced precisely the three regimes. Global κ proof is symbolic positivity, not sampled matrix values.
residual_risks: Independent finite verification only tests bounded instances; universal portions follow from reconstructed analytic proof.

final_claim: The unique orbit minimizing tr(L+κ sum_{v in S}e_v e_v^T)^{-1} among two distinct equal-gain leaders in simple K_{1,m,m+1}, for every m>=1 and every finite κ>0, is CC for m=1, BB for m=2 or3 and UB for m>=4.
limitations: Only unweighted complete tripartite K_{1,m,m+1}, two distinct equally positive finite gains, trace-inverse objective.
No assertion for heterogeneous leaders, noise models with edge disturbances, κ=0 or infinite-gain tie cases.
